title: DECISION: Scroll offset clamping prevents viewing invalid ranges
description:
What: clamp_scroll(visible_height) computes max = messages.len().saturating_sub(visible_height), then clamps scroll_offset to [0, max]. This ensures scroll_offset + visible_height never exceeds the message count.

Why it's good: The scroll offset is a derived quantity (messages below the fold), not a first-class buffer index. After any message list change or viewport resize, the old offset may be invalid. Clamping enforces the invariant: scroll_offset always points to a valid first visible line. Saturating math prevents underflow if there are fewer messages than the visible height. Prevents out-of-bounds reads by the render pass.
